INSERT INTO users (email, nombre, rol, hospital, updated_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.user.email }}',
  '{{ $json.user.name }} {{ $json.user.surname }}',
  '{{ $json.user.role }}',
  'HUNSC-Sur',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET
  nombre = EXCLUDED.nombre,
  rol = EXCLUDED.rol,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING *;
